data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation analysis considers a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both public equities (2 companies) and private rounds (8 companies), including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, treating total raised as a proxy for Seed valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implies a valuation of $7M. Peer-median triangulation across the five Defense & Security comparables—ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A)—yields a median of $1.0B, reflecting the substantial capitalization observed in this sector at comparable and adjacent stages.

The triangulated analysis produces a range of $6M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $504M. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and market-positioning heterogeneity within the peer set. Stage-progression provides a floor closer to current capital deployed, while peer-median is anchored by higher-stage rounds. Key uncertainties include Rebel Space's differentiation within an increasingly capitalized defense-tech landscape, path to revenue, and customer concentration risk, all of which would materially influence positioning within this range.
